items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I remember one day, we were supposed to play the United States Bond Hour, and Ragland and Duke had rehearsed together

ctx.x: Always a dirtyshirt. I said do you see Duke out there immaculate, and look at you. I said why don't you -- shucks, I remember one day, we were supposed to play the United States Bond Hour, and Ragland and Duke had rehearsed together, they were going to play a number and we went to -- after rehearsal we went to this club and I said 'Ragland, hey don't drink too much because you got to get up in the morning.' Shucks, you know, Ragland got drunk and everytime I'd look up the waiter was saying 'that man over there…
Junior was out. He sure was.
